title: Opening the settings modal mid-pan strands the pan latch; stale pan_last fires one accumulated-delta Pan on modal close
detail: S key pressed while a pan drag is held: Toggle_Settings never clears inp.panning, the panel_open branch suppresses the release (and the poll guard's synthesized release), so pan_last freezes; on modal close the pan branch emits the whole modal-session mouse travel as one Pan delta.
recommended_fix: Clear the latch when Toggle_Settings opens (set inp.panning = false beside the press_swallowed reset), matching the begin_draw and start_run clears.

title: Window resize while zoomed bypasses the world-rect clamp — paper void visible until the next camera action
evidence:
main.odin:
		if rl.IsWindowResized() {
			rnd.view_compute(&app.view, rl.GetScreenWidth(), rl.GetScreenHeight(), &cat.balance)
		}
...
	fit := min(f32(v.win_w)/v.world_w, f32(v.win_h)/v.world_h)
	v.scale = fit * app.cam_zoom
	v.off_x = f32(v.win_w)/2 - app.cam_wx * v.scale
	v.off_y = f32(v.win_h)/2 - app.cam_wy * v.scale
detail: camera_update re-derives scale/off from the stored center every frame but never calls camera_clamp_center (it is only called inside camera_zoom_at/effect_pan at main.odin:1604/1625); after a resize the previously clamped center can lie outside the valid band, showing void beyond the world edge.
recommended_fix: Re-clamp the targets in camera_update (or immediately after view_compute on resize) via camera_clamp_center at the live fit/zoom/window dims.

title: Sub-notch wheel deltas truncate to identity with no cross-frame accumulator — slow trackpad scrolling never zooms
detail: i32(delta) truncates |delta|<1 to zero notches and nothing carries across frames; a steady slow trackpad scroll (e.g. 0.3/frame) never reaches a whole notch, so the zoom input is silently dead on trackpads.
recommended_fix: Carry a fractional residual on Input: accumulate per-frame wheel delta, fire camera_zoom_step only when |accum| >= 1, keep the remainder.

title: Wheel is dead at Game_Over — the NOC log scroll that the removed render-block provided in every mode is unreachable
location: app/input/mouse.odin:37-49 + app/main.odin (diff: removed render-block wheel read)
detail: mouse_map returns at Game_Over before wheel collection, and the NOC scroll now lives only in effect_zoom, reachable solely via the Zoom intent. The old render-block scroll ran in every mode; the debug log is now unscrollable at Game_Over.
recommended_fix: If Game_Over NOC scrolling matters, feed effect_zoom's NOC branch on a mode-independent path; otherwise document the dropped debug path as intentional.
